title: VedaGlow — Ayurvedic Skincare Brand
description: A complete brand identity for VedaGlow, an Ayurvedic skincare brand. The design captures the essence of purity, calm, and radiance through an earthy, botanical color palette and elegant typography. Deliverables include logo design, product packaging, and social media creatives for the launch campaign.

images.alt: VedaGlow Aloe Face Cream promotional ad
images.heading: Logo design
images.writeup:
Concept that we use: Nature + Radiance
The VedaGlow logo combines a botanical leaf and 
a glowing drop to represent the fusion of natural
ingredients and radiant skin. The leaf symbolizes
purity and herbal wisdom, while the drop reflects
skincare hydration and nourishment. 
The surrounding glow represents healthy,luminous
skin — the ultimate result of VedaGlow products

images.heading: Product Ad — Anti-Aging Serum
images.writeup: A visually rich ad for the Radiance Anti-Aging Serum, blending warm earth tones with elegant typography. The design emphasizes the product's natural, Ayurvedic ingredients and positions it as a premium skincare solution.

images.alt: VedaGlow Kumkumadi Glow Serum product packaging
images.heading: Packaging Design — Kumkumadi Glow Serum
images.writeup: Complete packaging design for the Kumkumadi Glow Serum. The packaging uses VedaGlow's signature earthy palette with botanical motifs, creating a cohesive brand experience from shelf to skincare routine.

images.alt: VedaGlow Kumkumadi Glow Serum social media ad
images.heading: Social Media Creative — Kumkumadi Serum
images.writeup: A social media promotional creative designed for VedaGlow's Kumkumadi Glow Serum launch campaign. The layout balances product photography with descriptive text, optimized for engagement on Instagram and Facebook.

images.alt: VedaGlow Aloe Face Cream shop now creative
images.heading: E-Commerce Creative — Shop Now
images.writeup: An e-commerce focused creative for the Aloe Face Cream, designed to drive conversions with a clear call-to-action and appealing product presentation. The warm, inviting aesthetic aligns with VedaGlow's brand identity.
